cards.card_text: The highest priest must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God.
cards.verse_text: He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him.
cards.snippet: He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil…

cards.card_text: So he won't desecrate God's sanctuaries So the altar fire keeps burning So he can rest from his work
cards.verse_text: but because he has a defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries.
cards.snippet: …go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries.

cards.verse_text: Then Josiah brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense.

cards.card_text: Why does Josiah desecrate Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom?
cards.verse_text: He also desecrated Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so that no one could sacrifice his son or daughter in the fire to Molech.
cards.snippet: He also desecrated Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so that no one could sacrifice…

cards.card_text: They'll desecrate those idols and throw them away like menstrual cloths, saying to them, "Be gone!" Then the prophet turns to the seed they've sown in the ground.
cards.verse_text: So you will desecrate your silver-plated idols and your gold-plated images.
cards.snippet: So you will desecrate your silver-plated idols and your gold-plated images.

cards.card_text: The altars will be desecrated, the idols smashed and obliterated, and their works blotted out.
cards.verse_text: Wherever you live, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and desecrated, your idols smashed and obliterated, your incense altars cut down, and your works blotted out.

cards.card_text: God says He is about to desecrate the desire of Israel's eyes, the pride of their power.
cards.verse_text: Tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I am about to desecrate My sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and the delight of your soul.

cards.card_text: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress.
cards.verse_text: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress.
cards.snippet: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress.

cards.card_text: Tertullus says Paul even tried to desecrate the temple, so they ___ him.
cards.verse_text: and he even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.
cards.snippet: and he even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.
